title: Additional main screen graph interactions
body:
Currently one can tap on finger prick blood glucose measurements and see what they are/get the option to use them for calibration. All good.

One can also tap on historic CGM data and get the time/value, as well as tapping on the prediction curve to get the same data. For both of these it would be good to add a title/blurb to say that it's either recorded CGM or modelled/projected data.

One can also click on other curves, which have different (unlisted) axes - i.e. the insulin curve and the carbohydrate on board curves (as well as others, and I've no idea what they represent!). 

These all return values in mmol/l (of mg/dl if you must), which is wrong. It would be nice to return a message saying what the curve is as well as the actual value and time pair - this would also help with people understanding what all the different curves mean.
